text:
jordan_support: FYI customer hitting intermittent 502/504s when using streaming generate with very long prompts + long auth token. Customer says failures only when stream=true and the body is > ~100KB. They see SDK retry loops. Request ID: req_0a9c3f2b4d.

jordan_support: Repro steps from customer (copied):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVC...(very long token)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d @big_prompt.json \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?stream=true
```

jordan_support: They provided this truncated gateway log snippet:
```
gateway-edge-02 | recv from client: Authorization: "Bearer eyJhbGc... (truncated)
backend | upstream returned 502: header too long
```

jordan_support: Customer says switching to stream=false works reliably. Also reported that their SDK keeps retrying with 503/502 which makes the load worse.

rami_eng: can you paste the full gateway trace id and a full sample of raw headers (if available)? need to know whether header was truncated by edge or dropped by lb.

jordan_support: Uploaded full headers to the case. Key bits:
```
request_id: req_0a9c3f2b4d
trace_id: trace-52b7c
client: customer-service-1 (eu-west-1)
headers-length: ~12kb
```
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-15T09:12:03Z to namespace/hosted-api completed (sha: a1b2c3). No obvious failures during deploy. :rocket:

sophia_ops: tagging in ops. Looking at edge-01/02 NGINX logs + LB. There's a recent change (yesterday) that lowered `large_client_header_buffers` from `4 32k` to `4 8k` to try to save memory on the autoscaled pool. That could definitely cause header truncation for very long Authorization lines.

alex_m: also checking LB keepalive settings — some clients stream long payloads and the connection churn plus small header buffers = intermittent 502s. Will confirm if HAProxy is reporting `http-request header too large`.

nora_sre: I grep'd edge logs for req_0a9c3f2b4d. Found: 
```
2026-03-15T09:17:02Z gateway-edge-02 ERROR upstream returned 502, reason: "header too long", client_ip=10.4.2.40, bytes=0, trace=trace-52b7c
2026-03-15T09:17:02Z gateway-edge-02 DEBUG headers raw:
  Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXV...<truncated>
```

nora_sre: HAProxy on edge reports: `%HPREQ 헤더 길이 초과 (header too large)` in the same timeframe.

rami_eng: hypothesis: the combination of a very long Authorization header (customer tokens are fairly long base64 blobs) + smaller `large_client_header_buffers` caused the header to be dropped/truncated, leading NGINX/HAProxy to return 502/504 while the SDK retries and exacerbates load.

rami_eng: immediate mitigations we can try:
- increase `large_client_header_buffers` on edge proxies back to `4 32k` and reload nginx (low risk).
- route affected customer traffic to an older pool with the previous buffer settings while we patch.
- add a temporary server-side rate-limit on retry bursts for streaming endpoints to avoid retry amplification.

sophia_ops: i'm going to roll the buffer increase to edge-01/02 now, reload nginx and watch errors. applying to the rest of pool if green.

sophia_ops: command run: 
```
for host in edge-01 edge-02; do ssh $host 'sudo sed -i "s/large_client_header_buffers 4 8k;/large_client_header_buffers 4 32k;/" /etc/nginx/nginx.conf && sudo nginx -s reload'; done
```

sophia_ops: reloaded both edges. monitoring: error rate for req_0a9c3f2b4d pattern dropped to near 0 within 90s. Will keep under observation for 30m.

jordan_support: great — I've told the customer we rolled a config change on our edge proxies and asked them to retry streaming. Suggested temporary workaround: use stream=false or shorten token if possible.

alex_m: also pushed a quick haproxy/keepalive follow-up: increased `timeout http-keep-alive` from 5s -> 30s for the edges handling long streams to reduce connect churn.

rami_eng: longer-term items I propose:
- add an entry in docs/SDK best practices about long tokens and streaming; recommend keeping auth short or using short-lived tokens.
- add defensive server-side validation to detect header length and return 4xx with clear error instead of 5xx when header is too long.
- add SDK change to detect large auth/token length and produce a clearer client-side error before retry looping.
- create an automated test that sends long headers during staging to prevent regressing buffer sizes.

jordan_support: i've scheduled a customer follow-up in 30m and will update case with repro + mitigation.

nora_sre: logging notes for postmortem: 
- root cause: config regression reduced `large_client_header_buffers` on edge pool during a memory-conserving change.
- trigger: long Authorization header + streaming mode causing larger combined header footprint.
- impact: intermittent 502/504s for streaming requests from customers with long tokens; exacerbated by client SDK retry amplification.

sophia_ops: creating incident ticket INC-2026-0315 and assigning to rami_eng (owner), nora_sre, alex_m.

jordan_support: sent customer update: 
"We applied a config fix on our edge proxies that should address the 502/504s you saw. Please retry the streaming request and let us know if you still see failures. As a temporary workaround, you can call with stream=false which we've seen succeed. We're also working on a longer-term fix and SDK improvements to avoid retry amplification." :thumbsup: 

jordan_support: customer confirmed retry succeeded 5 minutes after our change and reported a successful long-stream session (no retries). They asked for an ETA on permanent fix.

rami_eng: ETA for defensive server-side error -> 2 weeks (code + tests + canary). SDK improvements -> 1 week for quick client-side validation patch. Docs PR to follow.

sophia_ops: monitoring for 2h shows no recurrence for the affected patterns. I'll leave the incident ticket open until postmortem is done.

jordan_support: closing loop with customer: we'll share postmortem and planned dates. Thanks team.

nora_sre: adding postmortem owners/notes to the incident ticket and creating follow-up tasks: `edge-config-check` on deploy gating, `sdk-header-guard` and `streaming-retry-safeguard`.

alex_m: thumbs. :white_check_mark:

jordan_support: marking this thread resolved on our side, moving case to "monitoring". If customer sees anything else, we'll reopen.
